set.body: Replace the thin motion foundation with the sole reusable motion algorithm authority. Port and correct ScalaFIM rigid estimation, multiscale capture, application, acquisition timing, pose interpolation, diagnostics, and generic motion metrics onto typed frames, full Grid affines, Ravel-backed resampling, explicit workspaces, and SE(3)-correct updates. ScalaFIM retains BIDS/workflow/report/censoring adapters only. Exit requires asymmetric-oblique correctness, known-transform recovery, differential fixtures, JVM/Scala.js parity, allocation/performance evidence, downstream compatibility, and duplicate removal gates.
set.title: EPIC: Make reframe4s-motion the canonical reusable motion engine
